prerequisites: Fundamentos de Computadores y Redes (Fundamentals of Computers and Networks)
Introducción a la Programación (Introduction to Programming)

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to design and develop applications, ensuring their reliability, security, and quality, in accordance with ethical principles and current legislation and regulations.
Ability to select and evaluate computer systems, ensuring their reliability, security, and quality, in accordance with ethical principles and current legislation and regulations.
Ability to know, understand and evaluate the structure and architecture of computers, as well as the basic components that make them up.
Know the different types of computers, along with their characteristics and capabilities, that can be used as hardware support in the design and development of a computer system.
Be able to select and evaluate the most appropriate type of computer to provide a service ensuring the required quality characteristics.
Evaluate computer organization alternatives to improve their performance.
Understand the operation of the mechanisms provided by the architecture to support multitasking operating systems.
Know examples of the architecture and organization of real systems.

assessment_methods.method: Theoretical part (Control parcial 1 and Control parcial 2)
Practical part (Control parcial 1 and Control parcial 2)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the theoretical part counts 50% and requires a minimum of 40%. The practical part counts 40% and requires a minimum of 40%. The group work counts 10%. The final grade is calculated as: Note = NTeo x 0.5 + NPrac x 0.4 + TGrup x 0.1. If the minimum 40% in NTeo or NPrac is not reached, the final grade will be the lesser of 4.5 points and the result of the formula. For extraordinary calls, the theoretical part (50%) and practical part (40%) are assessed via single controls, and the group work grade (10%) is conserved from the ordinary call. For differentiated evaluation, the theoretical part counts 50% and the practical part 50%.
